title: WorkPulse payslip.issued v1
description: A payslip became available when its payroll run was finalized. Identifiers and period only — amounts, deduction lines and run totals are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/features/payroll.md` → Events; `.ai/security.md`).

run_id.description: The payroll run that issued the payslip (UUIDv7 string).

employee_id.description: Employee the payslip belongs to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

period.description: Calendar-month period the payslip covers (`YYYY-MM`, e.g. `2026-09`).
